ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert from 'react-native' is silently no-op on the web preview. Clicking 'AI' with an empty task title and 'Calculate Final Timeline' with an empty SCC both produce zero user-visible feedback (no native window.alert, no RN-web modal, no inline error text). Verified by injecting a window.alert override before navigation — 0 calls captured. This breaks the required UX: spec says 'expect inline alert SCC required'.

The 'Calculate Final Timeline' button, the 'AI' button, the 'Add sub-task' button, 'Add risk' button, the SCC TextInput and the Task Title TextInput have no testID. Test agents must rely on placeholder/text which is brittle.

The '+' (add goal) and checkbox (Action Tracker shortcut) icon buttons in the GEM header do not expose testID attributes, so the new GEM → Action Tracker bridge cannot be reliably automated. The icons are visible in the header but not selectable by text.

Driver cells in the 7×7 Matrix (Capability/Commitment/Quantity/etc.) have no testID. Currently selectable only by text (e.g., page.get_by_text('Capability')) which matches all 7 divisions — using .first() is brittle. Add testID like 'org-cell-{division_code}-{driver_code}'.
Spec says '3 buttons (Up-to-mark / Moderate / Inadequate)' but actual scoring modal button text is 'Up-to-the-mark'. Confirm canonical wording with main agent and align spec OR rename label.

integration_issues.issue: Without visible alerts on web, the user cannot tell whether SCC is required, sub-tasks are required, or AI failed. They will perceive the buttons as broken. Recommended fix: wrap Alert.alert in a Platform.OS === 'web' branch that renders a small <View>/<Text> inline error, OR use react-native-paper / custom modal.

issues: The tab labels 'Profes...' and 'Resour...' are truncated on a 390px mobile width; consider shorter labels (e.g., 'Pro', 'Res') or making the tab strip horizontally scrollable so the full label is visible on tap.

The 'ATEX' purple chip sits inline with the kebab/menu and routines header — on 390px width it is readable but the chip occupies ~45px of right gutter; verify it doesn't collide with notification dots on devices with safe-area insets.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/tools/atex.tsx imports Alert from 'react-native' and uses Alert.alert(...) for all validation surfaces. react-native-web 0.21 does NOT reliably wire Alert.alert to window.alert in this project (verified empirically — 0 alerts fire on click). The same anti-pattern likely exists across many tools/* screens (ATEX, ctt-task, lifestyle, contacts, solution-finder all use Alert.alert) so ALL their validation feedback is invisible on the web preview. A central web-safe Alert utility is required.

Tab strip in the Contact Edit modal truncates 'Professional' to 'Profes...' on 390px width, which is misleading because clicking the truncated tab is what reveals the Roles & Organizations panel. Use shorter labels or horizontal scroll.

rca_of_issue: ATEX no-alert RCA: /app/frontend/app/tools/atex.tsx line 7 imports Alert from 'react-native'. On the web target this resolves to react-native-web's Alert which in v0.21 has been observed to not always delegate to window.alert (likely depending on app shell / wrapper config). Reproduction: open /tools/atex on web preview, fill nothing, click 'Calculate Final Timeline' → expected pop-up 'SCC required' → observed nothing in DOM, no window.alert, no [role=alertdialog]. Mitigation: introduce a tiny helper, e.g., `const showAlert = (t,m) => Platform.OS==='web' ? setInlineError({t,m}) : Alert.alert(t,m)` with a banner View rendered conditionally; OR use a global ToastContext.
